release_notes: Entry rejection handling could unwind live positions that were never actually rejected: an async accept-then-reject race in Kite's RMS could leave an order reading REJECTED in the order book while the position had actually filled. `_cancel_and_rollback` now cross-checks `broker.positions()` before trusting a REJECTED verdict, and no longer auto-closes long legs (LC/LP) when only short siblings are rejected — those are parked into `_long_active` instead. `edit_trade_state`: `confirm_active` — manual, broker-verified escape hatch to move a `PARTIAL_ENTRY_FAILED` trade's rejected legs into `ACTIVE`, for state predating the fix above.
